whyThisReaderIsIndependent: FABLE-VA12 built none of these five families, repaired none of them, rastered none of them, and authored none of the records it scored them against. theDecisiveFindings.oneLine: The platform marks the item 3h statutory election on a sworn petition while the participant page says it never marks a box on a sworn filing, and the committed manifest assigns that election to the participant.
theDecisiveFindings.howItWasFound: Text extraction from the two canonical CR-409s is byte-identical (md5 9f49fb8a37a937c9), so the only difference between the matter-of-right and interests-of-justice variants is invisible to a text instrument. Decompressing the page-2 content stream showed two black 1.2pt diagonal strokes forming an X, inset 2pt inside the li3h widget box at (84.5, 409.44)-(93.5, 418.44) in one variant and at y 364.85/369.85 in the other.
theDecisiveFindings.standard: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A4's internal-consistency rule, with A2 answersVT8C4 supplying that the committed packet-set manifest is a held source.

theDecisiveFindings.oneLine: The Option 1 perjury declaration's date line is delivered carrying 12/15/2022, in a field this family's own blanks report classifies PROTECTED_FIELD and the participant page promises is blank.
theDecisiveFindings.howItWasFound: The ink is source-authored, so no build-side counter can see it - protectedWrites, refusedFieldsWithInk and nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes are all clean, and the raster gate measured 30 pages with 0 problems because the date renders perfectly. What settles it is that the build already strips source-authored appearances: the source's stray 0 in Total Value of Property (page 7, x 315.44) and stray 0 in Total Monthly Expenses (page 8, x 320.22) are both absent from the delivered packet. Two financial values sanitised; the one on the protected signature-date line kept.

theDecisiveFindings.oneLine: Eight components are declared by two independent held records that agree with each other; five are delivered, and two of the five carry identifiers neither record declares.
theDecisiveFindings.howItWasFound: The track registry's packetSet.components and legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json were compared componentId by componentId and order by order against the delivered componentSet. Missing and required: wa_vac...-records-checklist-3, wa_vac...-filing-instructions-4 (delivered under an undeclared id in the checklist's ordinal), wa_del_nonconviction-records-checklist-2, -expectation-setting-3 and -accuracy-remedy-guidance-4.

theDecisiveFindings.oneLine: The non-conviction deletion page asks a court for relief on a route the repository records four ways as having no court in it, and contradicts itself on its own page.
theDecisiveFindings.howItWasFound: Read from the delivered bytes. Page 8 prints "The petitioner, Jordan Avery Reyes, applies to this court under RCW 10.97.060..." and, six lines below, quoting the record, "The request goes to the Washington State Patrol rather than to a court: it is an agency request, not a petition." Page 10 asks "the court to grant the relief"; page 11 prints "No court is involved and no order is sought" and "Venue: Not a court route."
theDecisiveFindings.standard: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A4, failing under the obligation that carries the false sentence.

theDecisiveFindings.oneLine: The BCI components the manifest orders 1 and 2, and that this route's own law requires first, are delivered last on pages 17 to 19 behind all seven court documents.
theDecisiveFindings.howItWasFound: The manifest's components[].order (1..10) compared against the delivered pageManifest, which as component numbers reads 4, 5, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1, 2. The petition's paragraph 1 asks for the BCI certificate number that pages 17 to 19 have to produce. The same inversion is in every Utah sibling on this build host while their manifests declare the identical order, so the repair is a shared-host repair.

In the WA packet three of the four captions are the same benign shape, and the fourth is where the FILING_DESTINATION failure lives: the agency-route page carries a court caption on an instrument the repository says never reaches a court.
twoFurtherBlindCountersFoundHere: requiredComponentsMissing recomputed 0 for rcap-wa-custom-pleading-clean-tracks while five required components are missing. The counter runs over the family's own field map, which describes what the build made; it cannot see components the build never made because nothing in the family's own records mentions them. It is measuring the build against itself. Same shape as the caption blind spot, on a different counter.

protectedWrites recomputed 0 for rcap-tx-custom-pleading while a protected field carries ink. The counter counts ink the BUILD added. Ink that arrived inside the official source's own field appearance and was carried through is outside every build-side instrument, and the central raster gate cannot help because the ink renders correctly.
whereZeroCountersWereNotAnswers.andWhereZeroWasAnAnswer: For all five families the nine completeness counters were re-run in this container and all forty-five cells returned 0 with PASS_COMPLETE. Every one of those readings is reported as true and as narrow: not one of the nine counters compares a packet's page order against its manifest's declared component order, and not one opens the track registry's selfHelpStopConditions.
